reason: Use GPUs whenever remaining memory is sufficient; do not wait for zero utilization.

changes.panorama_visible_gpus: all capacity-qualified GPUs; five in the successful formal dispatch
changes.panorama_physical_gpu_order: capacity-qualified order recorded at dispatch; formal run used physical GPUs 0,1,2,3,4
changes.panorama_weight_cap_gib_per_visible_gpu: min(40, floor(free_GiB)-14) on the VAE card; min(40, floor(free_GiB)-8) elsewhere, with a 4 GiB lower bound used only when aggregate dispatch remains valid
changes.panorama_device_map: Accelerate auto; CPU weight offload only when aggregate capacity requires it
changes.panorama_host_staging_scope: transport only; activations and structural tensors retain dtype and values
changes.panorama_local_checkpoint_validation: 32/32 shards, exact size match, index and final-shard SHA-256 match source
changes.node_local_python_environment_provenance: file-for-file staging copy of baselines/envs/hyworld2 excluding regenerable __pycache__; original symbolic links preserved; verified Python 3.11.4, torch 2.7.1+cu128, numpy 1.26.4 and CUDA availability
changes.node_local_panorama_source_provenance: staging copy of the frozen locally patched baselines/sources/HY-World-2.0 tree excluding .git, assets, examples and __pycache__; no source or parameter change
changes.node_local_panorama_compat_provenance: materialized copy of the frozen transformers 4.57.6 and huggingface_hub 0.36.2 compatibility overlay
changes.nfs_retry_policy: an attempt blocked in rpc_wait before model-ready and before any sample output is an infrastructure-only attempt; terminate, retain its log, and resume from validated outputs using node-local staging
changes.formal_heavy_output_mapping: each formal side's scene/native/render_results, scene/native/gs_data and scene/gs are symlinked to the node-local staging tree; manifests, canonical renders, annotations and metric results remain below baselines
changes.minimum_free_shared_disk_basis: On 2026-09-12 the shared filesystem fell from more than 120 GiB free to 53 GiB because of unrelated jobs. Formal HY-World heavy outputs (render_results, gs_data and gs) are symlinked to /tmp, which had 244 GiB free; the pilot measured only about 16 MiB of canonical renders per successful side, so the remaining HY-World shared-filesystem footprint is about 3.2 GiB plus small manifests, navigation metadata and metrics. A 20 GiB reserve therefore remains conservative while avoiding a false abort.

changes.trajectory_vlm_service_policy: reuse the healthy exact local Qwen service for trajectory planning; do not start a duplicate or terminate the pre-existing process

changes.aqs_vlm_service_policy: the first evaluation driver was interrupted while its newly launched exact service was still loading; after that service became healthy, external-LLM evaluation reused it for all 210 frozen AQS requests, and the experiment-owned process group was terminated after scoring
changes.trajectory_planning_dispatch: five disjoint spec shards, one generation GPU each, shared external Qwen service
changes.trajectory_rendering_dispatch: five disjoint spec shards when five capacity-qualified GPUs are available
changes.world_expansion_dispatch: one resident two-GPU job at a time; formal retries showed that concurrent independent WorldStereo instances could stall in the first compiled forward, and later repeated cold starts on physical GPUs 0/1 entered the same long-kernel state; the unchanged replay-warmed batch was migrated to capacity-qualified physical GPUs 3/4 and completed all 31 pending formal sides
changes.world_expansion_node_local_cache_provena: uid-private rsync staging copy of the existing Table-2 TorchInductor, Triton, CUDA, torch-extension and matplotlib caches; cache and temporary writes stay node-local and do not change checkpoints, inputs, tensors or outputs
changes.world_expansion_replay_cache_provenance: fresh uid-private rsync staging copy of the original baselines/hyworld2_runtime/cache/uid_2002 plus the existing Hugging Face, torch, torch-extension and matplotlib caches; used after the post-success mutable cache repeatedly stalled at the first CUDA forward, without changing checkpoints, inputs, seeds, tensors, or outputs
changes.world_expansion_scratch_warmup_policy: prepend one unreported uid-private scratch replay of food_service_timber_traditional_07/seed_0/interior, the exact first scene of the successful 144-side resident batch, with both its generation bank and cached worldstereo-memory-dmd_result.mp4 removed; this forces the previously observed complete known-good model forward before reported scenes, and the scratch output is never copied into formal data or included in validators, attempt counts, and aggregation
changes.world_expansion_scratch_warmup_seed_safe: video_gen.py calls set_seed(scene_seed + data_rank) and creates a freshly manual-seeded torch.Generator at the beginning of every scene, so the scratch scene cannot advance or alter any reported scene's frozen method seed
changes.world_expansion_cold_start_evidence: the resident batch beginning with food_service_timber_traditional_07/seed_0/interior completed 144 reported sides at about 17 seconds per side, while multiple later cold starts reproducibly entered a roughly 100 W CUDA busy loop before the first output; a pilot-residence scratch also reproduced that stall, so the replay warm-up is pinned to the exact first input of the successful resident batch
changes.gs_data_dispatch: capacity-qualified two-GPU shards ran opportunistically on physical GPU pairs 0/1, 2/5 and 3/4; one larger 2/5 shard was stopped only after a clean completed-spec boundary, validated outputs were retained, and its remaining disjoint specs were resharded
